item.title: Chiwetel Ejiofor to Star Alongside Scarlett Johansson in New EXORCIST Movie for Blumhouse/Universal
item.description: Oscar nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor (The Old Guard, Doctor Strange and the Multiverse of Madness) has joined the cast of Mike Flanagan’s Untitled Exorcist film. The project reteams Ejiofor with Flanagan, who directed him in The Life of Chuck. Flanagan wrote the script and is directing and producing the new feature that he promises is a “fresh and bold” take on the material. item.title: DAREDEVIL: BORN AGAIN Season 3 Locks in Filming Start and Drops Early Casting Clues
item.description: Marvel Studios is already looking ahead with Daredevil’s gritty comeback, even as fans gear up for the next chapter. Fresh details have surfaced about Daredevil: Born Again Season 3, revealing when cameras will roll and what kinds of characters are about to stalk the streets of Hell’s Kitchen. It’s an encouraging sign that Marvel Television is feeling confident about where this story is headed.Even though Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 hasn’t hit Disney+ yet, the long game is clearly in motion.

item.title: YouTube Just Crossed $60 Billion in 2025 Revenue and Became Bigger Than Netflix
item.description: YouTube had a monster year, and its parent company Alphabet finally put a clean number on just how massive the platform has become. For the first time ever, the company broke out YouTube’s total annual revenue, and the result is impressive. item.title: Sam Raimi Shares His Favorite Spider-Man Web-Swinging Scene and it Defined Peter Parker For Him
item.description: Sam Raimi helped change the course of superhero movies when Spider-Man hit theaters in 2002. At the time, comic book films were still finding their footing. Blade and X-Men opened the door, but Raimi’s take on Peter Parker kicked it wide open. Seeing Spider-Man in action was unlike anything we’ve seen before.
